boundary: Evidence density is descriptive. It is not a quality score or release authority.

eras.label: Language before public implementation evidence
eras.limitations: Strong claims remain historical framing; public posts do not establish capabilities.

eras.label: Repositories and initial tests appear
eras.limitations: Repository existence does not prove every public description.

eras.label: Decision states, tests, releases, and receipts become explicit
eras.limitations: Bounded evaluations and receipts are not universal safety proof.

eras.label: Public product, Benchmark, Workspace, Genesis, and Skill Forge
eras.limitations: Workspace historical persistence and marketplace admission remain dependency-held.
